beats.narration: When I was eight I said I wanted to be a scientist. I did not talk much. I wore sunglasses everywhere. Mom got very excited every time and seemed proud of me.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Quiet childhood hope and the warmth of being encouraged.

beats.narration: We watched Yugioh GX together and it was our thing. My little brother was two years younger than me. My older sister was seven years older than me. We battled each other with our cards.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Playful belonging during shared sibling evenings.

beats.narration: At seventeen I got my license and my two thousand Honda Accord Coupe with faded paint and no air conditioning. I graduated early and went to a coding bootcamp. At nineteen I got my first software engineering job.
Mia, I met my wife on a dating app for Muslims. Every week at eight pm she showed up on Facetime. I love you even when I do not show it. I remember her at eight on Facetime.
beats.emotionalPurpose: Steady tenderness and reassurance for Mia.
